title: AuthProvider::auth_header returns owned (String, String) per call
description: AuthProvider::auth_header() returns Option<(String, String)>. Both BearerAuth and BasicAuth pre-compute and store the header string, then clone it on every call (auth.rs lines 158-162, 211-215). The header name is also freshly allocated from AUTHORIZATION.as_str().to_string() on every call. Since the stored string never changes, returning a reference (Option<(&str, &str)>) with a lifetime tied to &self would eliminate all per-call allocation and the AUTHORIZATION.as_str().to_string() idiom. Alternative that keeps owned: at minimum replace AUTHORIZATION.as_str().to_string() with 'authorization'.to_owned() or a &'static str constant.
